evals.prompt: Members keep asking for NFL player props. Can we add them to the main product next week?
evals.expected_output: Draws the league-by-bet-type grid, marks cells full or open, and rules the request outside the grid as no until full.
expectations: Shows the grid of leagues by bet types, the owner's or a marked proposal
Marks each cell full or open with evidence or the missing piece
Rules NFL props a no until the grid is full, with a reason and a reopen trigger
Names the next open cell to work on with an owner and leaves any grid change to the owner

evals.prompt: We're doing NBA, NHL, college football and college hoops, plus MLB totals and some soccer. Is that too much? Cut the list.
evals.expected_output: Cuts work back to the grid and orders the open cells.
expectations: Separates work inside the grid from work outside it
Gives MLB totals and soccer the verdict no until full, each with a reopen trigger
Uses a stated full test, such as every slate for 14 days graded against the closing line
Routes any live change through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's word

evals.prompt: The owner approved a 30-day MLB totals experiment. Set the loss cap and kill date.
